warm.name: Warm
warm.desc: Genuine goodwill — this person is on your side right now.

hopeful.name: Hopeful
hopeful.desc: Something good feels within reach — and you are part of it.

calculating.name: Calculating
calculating.desc: Every sentence is being weighed. This is business, not affection.

wary.name: Wary
wary.desc: Guard up. They are watching for the catch in everything you say.

anxious.name: Anxious
anxious.desc: Fear sits at the table — of failure, exposure or being dropped.

irritated.name: Irritated
irritated.desc: Patience is thin. One wrong word and the conversation tips.

resentful.name: Resentful
resentful.desc: An old wound, kept fresh. They have not forgotten what you did.

resigned.name: Resigned
resigned.desc: They stopped expecting anything from you. That is the coldest state of all.
